note: Photos hidden from their gallery for being near-duplicates of a neighbour (not deleted: files and rows stay). Hidden = media.published 0. Undo one: delete its entry (or run scripts/curate-galleries.mjs --restore <id|gallery>), then rerun the publisher or the script. 'covers' puts one photo first in a gallery (was = its old position).
